translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ROMA
book.title: Dos Sulat ni Pablo Atag to mgo Toho ROMA

content: Id Podmotallong to Monama si Abraham pomon to Kopomakoy Rin
Poomdomma row man si Abraham no kovuyyahan ta no mgo Judio. Ondan kos unayan no id podmotallong sikandin to Monama?
Na otik id podmotallong pa sikandin to Monama pomon to moppiyon pinuungan din, duwon nanoy unayan nod pokopobporoong sikandin. Piru iyon bonnaa, waa en id pokopobporoong din diyon to Monama.
Nosorollan ta ini, oyyos no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: “Id pomakoy si Abraham taddot id ikahi to Monama woy pomon tadda, id podmotallong din sikandin.”

content: Ponunggeleng, otik duwon minuvu nod puung, od boyaran en sikandin. Dos bayad kandin, konna od ko-oseng no gasa, su id oiluggatan din man idda.
Piru iddos minuvu nod salig to Monama no id posinsya taddot mosaasaa, od komotallong sikandin diyot kod-ontong to Monama ukit to kopomakoy rin, konna ukit to moppiyon pinuungan din.
Ini en kos kohulugan taddot id ikahi ni Harin David, no moppiya kod kotomanan taddot minuvu no id podmotallong to Monama, konna ukit to moppiyon pinuungan.

content.text: “Moppiya kod kotomanan taddot minuvu nid posinsyan
woy dos mgo saa rin, id lingawan don to Monama.
Moppiya kod kotomanan taddot minuvu no id podwora to Monama iddos mgo saa rin.”

content: Na moka-atag taddot moppiyon kotomanan nid ikahi ni David, atag da vo idda to mgo Judio no duwon botasanon to kodpotupu? Konna en! Su atag en mandad idda taddot konna mgo Judio, ahad konna ran botasanon iddos kodpotupu. Nosorollan tad iddos no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Id pomakoy si Abraham to Monama woy pomon tadda, id podmotallong din sikandin.”

content: Na, kannu man id podmotallong to Monama si Abraham? Iddot timpu vo no notupuwan don sikandin? Konna, su notomanan idda to waa pa sikandin notupu-i.

Woy dos kodpotupu rin, patow no tapoy ron sikandin id podmotallong to Monama ukit to kopomakoy rin. De-en id ngoranan sikandin no amoy to langun nod pompomakoy no id podmotallong to Monama, ahad waa ran notopu-i.
Woy sikandin mandad kos amoy taddot mgo notupuwan, konna ra pomon to notupuwan sikandan, ko konna, pomon to kopomakoy ran no iling taddot kopomakoy ni Abraham to waa pa sikandin notupu-i.
Dos Dakkoon Kodsalig ni Abraham taddot Tandu to Monama

Dangan, id totandu kos Monama ki Abraham woy taddot kandin no koubbaran, no od kokomunoy ran inis ingod. Id tandu idda to Monama, konna pomon to kodtuman ni Abraham taddot mgo Suhu, ko konna, pomon to kopomakoy rin, de-en id podmotallong sikandin to Monama.
Su otik idda ra en so mgo minuvu nid tuman to mgo Suhu kos od pokotanggap taddot id tandu to Monama, waa koru-anon to kopomakoy ta, ahad iddos tandu rin.
Oyyos od kosahapan to mgo minuvu iddos lampas no langot woy silut to Monama pomon to dii sikandan od pokotuman taddot mgo Suhu. Ponunggeleng, otik waa iddos mgo Suhu, waa mandad od pokosupak.

Purisu iddos tandu to Monama, od kotuman ukit da en to kopomakoy. Dos unayan no id totandu kos Monama, su amoy id pokoposivonnaa rin iddos kopiyannoy rin taddot langun no koubbaran ni Abraham. Na iddos tandu rin, konna ra atag to mgo Judio nod tuman taddot mgo Suhu, ko konna, atag en to langun nid pomakoy iling ki Abraham. Oyyos sikandin kos amoy to langun nod pomakoy.
Iling taddot no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: Id aam ku sikkow nod kovovallan no amoy to mo-uraan ingod.”

content: Na notuman idda, oyyos sikandin kos amoy ta riyot kod-ontong to Monama. Woy dos Monama nid pomokayan ni Abraham, idda en mandad kos Monama no duwon kotuusan nod badnow taddot id poomatoy ron, woy od pokobovaa sikandin to ahad ondan nid kopi-i rin ukit da to sokkad no kahi.

Na ahad imman to dii od kotuman iddon tandu, id pomakoy si Abraham nod tumanon en to Monama iddos id tandu rin. De-en novovallan sikandin no amoy to mo-uraan ingod, iling taddot id ikahi to Monama kandin no,

content.text: “Dos ko-uralloy to koubbaran du, od poko-iling to mgo bitu-on diyot langit.”

content: To id totandu kos Monama ki Abraham, mgo sokkad no gatus don kos idad din, woy nosorollan din no pomon to kovuyyahoy rin, dii ron en sikandin od poko-anak pa ukit taddot sawa rin no si Sara. Nokosaddoo mandad sikandin no iddos sawa rin, dii en od poko-anak. Piru ahad ungketen, waa id moomet kos kopomakoy rin.
Waa en sikandin id duworuwa nod tumanon to Monama iddos tandu rin, ko konna, id mosalig pe-en kos kopomakoy rin woy id doong din kos Monama.
Su dakkoo kos kodsalig din no od tumanon en to Monama iddos tandu rin.
De-en pomon to kopomakoy ni Abraham, id podmotallong sikandin to Monama.
Piru inis kahi no, “id podmotallong si Abraham to Monama,” waa id sulat atag da ki Abraham,
ko konna, atag en mandad keta. Od komotallong ki riyot kod-ontong to Monama, su id pomakoy ki kandin no id badnow ki Disas Krays nod Longaggon ta.
Oyyos id boggoy to Monama si Disas no od patoy atag to mgo saa ta, woy id badnow sikandin amoy'd komotallong ki riyot kod-ontong Monama.
